response.sql:
WITH team_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    SUM(games) as total_home_games
  FROM home_game
  GROUP BY team_id
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    team_totals.team_id,
    total_home_games,
    SUM(total_home_games) OVER () as all_home_games,
    AVG(total_home_games) OVER () as avg_home_games
  FROM team_totals
  WHERE total_home_games IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  team_id,
  total_home_games,
  CAST(total_home_games AS NUMERIC) / CAST(all_home_games AS NUMERIC) as share_of_all_home_games,
  CAST(total_home_games AS NUMERIC) / avg_home_games as ratio_to_average
FROM stats
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The "games" column in home_game represents home games played. The schema also contains an "openings" column; "games" is the standard representation of games played.
